name: Crystal Freeze
description: Mouse freezes the image into growing ice crystals with physical light transmission. Features Voronoi-based crystal cells with Fresnel reflection, path absorption, and purity-based scattering.

params.name: Ice Purity
params.description: Crystal clarity: Pure ice transmits more light, cloudy ice scatters more

updatedParams.name: Freeze Decay
updatedParams.description: Persistence of the freeze mask between frames; bass adds up to +0.1, so loud passages hold the ice longer.

updatedParams.name: Crystal Size
updatedParams.description: Lattice frequency (10–50 cells) modulated +40% by mids; also sets the dendrite front advance rate.

updatedParams.name: Material IOR
updatedParams.description: Blends the refractive index between ice (0) and glass (1) for the facet dispersion.

updatedParams.name: Ice Purity
updatedParams.description: Inclusion density in the ice; treble lowers purity further, muddying the facet bursts.
